meta.name: Borealis
meta.author: dustycompiler
meta.cadence: updates every 15 min via GitHub Action

dex.change_7d_meaning: percent change of 24h DEX volume vs the 24h from 7 days ago (not 7d-total vs prior 7d)

rwa.source: defillama.protocols chainTvls.Solana where category in {RWA, RWA Lending}

active_addresses.note: solana.com/data publishes several vendor series for the same label. Values disagree; Borealis does not average them.

sampled.priority_note: priority est. = meta.fee − 5000×n_signatures (base fee 5000 lamports/sig). Sampled, NOT a 24h census.
sampled.source: Solana RPC getBlock meta.fee (finalized, time-stratified sample)
sampled.sampled_runrate_note: sum(meta.fee) 0.0405 SOL over 9956s × 86400. ESTIMATED 24h in-protocol fees from the stratified sample, not a ledger.
sampled.note: NOT a 24h census. Time-stratified getBlock sample: 2 adjacent tip blocks (spot) + 12 slots spread over a ~2.8h window (target 10800s; ≤160 txs/slot subsampled). n_tx=2240 all-tx, n_nonvote=1399, window_seconds=9956. p50 is all-tx meta.fee; non-vote p50 is separate. Do not read n=2240 as a 24h ledger — wall-clock window is 9956s.

economics.median_tx_fee_note: NOT a 24h census. Time-stratified getBlock sample: 2 adjacent tip blocks (spot) + 12 slots spread over a ~2.8h window (target 10800s; ≤160 txs/slot subsampled). n_tx=2240 all-tx, n_nonvote=1399, window_seconds=9956. p50 is all-tx meta.fee; non-vote p50 is separate. Do not read n=2240 as a 24h ledger — wall-clock window is 9956s.
economics.priority_note: priority est. = meta.fee − 5000×n_signatures (base fee 5000 lamports/sig). Sampled, NOT a 24h census.

jito.tips_24h_note: INVALID 24h run-rate = landed tip-floor p50 (0.00000832 SOL) × non-vote TPS (2944) × 86400. tip_floor is a per-bundle landed percentile, not paid by every non-vote tx, and is not a 24h Jito tape. Not included in headline REV. Not added from DeFiLlama.
jito.sensitivity: sensitivity (NOT a 24h aggregate, NOT headline REV): invalid run-rate at p50 floor → 228537 USD; at p95 floor → 13102567 USD.
jito.sensitivity_note: sensitivity (NOT a 24h aggregate, NOT headline REV): invalid run-rate at p50 floor → 228537 USD; at p95 floor → 13102567 USD.

jito_runrate_not_rev.note: INVALID 24h run-rate = landed tip-floor p50 (0.00000832 SOL) × non-vote TPS (2944) × 86400. tip_floor is a per-bundle landed percentile, not paid by every non-vote tx, and is not a 24h Jito tape. Not included in headline REV. Not added from DeFiLlama.
jito_runrate_not_rev.label: INVALID as a 24h aggregate — tip_floor is per-bundle landed percentile, not paid by every non-vote tx

economics.rev_definition: Full network REV (Blockworks/Helius) is in-protocol transaction fees (vote + base + priority) plus out-of-protocol Jito MEV tips. Jito tape: GET kobe.mainnet.jito.network/api/v1/daily_mev_rewards (no key). Gross tips = jito_tips + validator_tips (Jito-paid/retained vs validator-distributed; not inclusive; split is not a TipRouter fee rate). UTC calendar day, aligned to solana.com/data Fees date. REV USD uses that same day's solana.com/data SOL Price, not the live snapshot. Never mix dates. tip_floor × TPS is NOT REV. DeFiLlama protocol/application fees are NOT REV.
economics.rev_kind: MEASURED UTC calendar day 2026-08-25: in-protocol fees + gross Jito MEV tips (jito_tips + validator_tips; not a rolling 24h); USD uses solana.com/data SOL Price (DexPaprika) UTC 2026-08-25
economics.rev_sensitivity: sensitivity (NOT a 24h aggregate, NOT headline REV): invalid run-rate at p50 floor → 228537 USD; at p95 floor → 13102567 USD.

rev_components.label: Jito tip-floor run-rate (NOT REV)
rev_components.source: INVALID 24h run-rate = landed tip-floor p50 (0.00000832 SOL) × non-vote TPS (2944) × 86400. tip_floor is a per-bundle landed percentile, not paid by every non-vote tx, and is not a 24h Jito tape. Not included in headline REV. Not added from DeFiLlama.

rev_routes_tried.route: getBlock stratified sample run-rate (sum meta.fee / window_seconds × 86400)
rev_routes_tried.role: ESTIMATED in-protocol cross-check, not added (would double-count solana.com Fees)
INVALID as a 24h aggregate — sensitivity only, not headline REV
INVALID sensitivity only, not summed into REV
EXCLUDED — application/protocol fees, not network REV
MEASURED Jito gross MEV tips UTC day (jito_tips+validator_tips)

economics.total_rev_note: Full network REV (Blockworks/Helius) is in-protocol transaction fees (vote + base + priority) plus out-of-protocol Jito MEV tips. Jito tape: GET kobe.mainnet.jito.network/api/v1/daily_mev_rewards (no key). Gross tips = jito_tips + validator_tips (Jito-paid/retained vs validator-distributed; not inclusive; split is not a TipRouter fee rate). UTC calendar day, aligned to solana.com/data Fees date. REV USD uses that same day's solana.com/data SOL Price, not the live snapshot. Never mix dates. tip_floor × TPS is NOT REV. DeFiLlama protocol/application fees are NOT REV. This run: MEASURED UTC calendar day 2026-08-25: in-protocol fees + gross Jito MEV tips (jito_tips + validator_tips; not a rolling 24h); USD uses solana.com/data SOL Price (DexPaprika) UTC 2026-08-25. Protocol fees 15169688.78 USD are listed separately and excluded.
economics.rev_spot_note: spot equivalent at this run SOL-USD; not the headline REV USD

jito_daily.accounting: gross_mev_tips_sol = jito_tips + validator_tips (jito_tips = Jito-paid/retained; validator_tips = validator-distributed; separate components, not inclusive; split is not a TipRouter protocol-fee rate)

parts.detail: mean slot 367 ms vs 400 ms target (400→30, 800→0)
TPS 4,811 vs solana.com/data Transaction Count (Total)|Allium / 86400 3,577 (ratio capped at 1.0)

RT by @solana_devs: There are 2 ways to vote on SGPs:

1. Connect your validator identity or stake account withdraw authority to https://governance.solana.com to vote via the UI.
2. Use the svmgov command line tool: https://crates.io/crates/svmgov to vote with your validator identity or your stake account withdraw authority.  Docs for svmgov are here: https://docs.governance.solana.com/svmgov/

The voting ends in just under 24 hours at the end of epoch 1023. Go Vote! 🗳️

archive.summary: Tokenized equities expanded, real-world assets hit $3.73B, payments reached 330,000+ merchants, and block capacity increased 66% in a milestone month.

archive.summary: The last cycle was built on software and cheap money. This one is built from steel, silicon, and energy; and the tokens moving the capital behind it. Speaker applications are now live for Breakpoint 2026:

archive.title: Inside Solana’s Growing Market for Tokenized Cards and Physical Collectibles
archive.summary: Collector Crypt has crossed $1.6B in volume as Solana apps bring vaulted cards, packs, buybacks, and physical redemption onchain.

archive.title: Overview of Institutional Real World Assets on Solana
archive.summary: Learn how BlackRock, J.P. Morgan, Visa, Franklin Templeton, and other institutions are building the future of tokenized real-world assets on Solana.

archive.summary: The Resource and Inclusion Fees SIMD was accepted alongside new Agave, Firedancer, and program SDK releases.

archive.title: Deploying enterprise stablecoin rails on Solana in days with Crossmint

archive.title: Rent Reduction on Solana: A Data-Backed Analysis

timeline_public.item: solana.com/news “Lowering Slot Time and Validators Economic” is the primary public write-up for the SIMD-525 listing token (SIMD-0525).
SIMD-0525 created (Anza). Four feature gates: 350/300/250/200 ms.
Agave v4.2 schedule targeted the four SIMD-0525 steps on mainnet one epoch apart; schedule is tentative. First step is 400→350 ms.
Observed mean slot 367 ms is consistent with the 350 ms SIMD-0525 target (staged 400→350→300→250→200). INFERRED corroboration, not a feature-gate RPC.
SIMD-0387 (BLS pubkey in vote account) activated on mainnet.
SIMD-0357 VAT activated. VAT does not itself turn on Alpenglow consensus.

watch: Whether observed slot time stays near the inferred SIMD-0525 target after the next epoch.
Skip rate / skipped slots as later 50 ms steps (300/250/200) are considered.
Agave 4.2 / 4.3 stake rollout vs the published (tentative) schedule.
Firedancer / Frankendancer Votor parity before a full Alpenswitch.
